question: What does a linear combination mean intuitively?
direct_answer: It is a vector built by scaling and adding other vectors.
expanded_answer: A linear combination asks what you can form from a set of vectors if you are allowed to weight each one by a scalar and sum the results. In ML, this is the core idea behind mixing features, combining basis directions, and expressing embeddings as coordinates in a learned space.
key_points: Describes what can be constructed from a set of vectors
common_wrong_ideas: A linear combination is the same as elementwise multiplication
Only two vectors can be combined linearly
